comments.author: Li Yue
comments.body: ...Forget the Famagusta tree... The Berry Shack is even better for collecting berries. Especially once you start procuring mice in Famagusta.

comments.author: Sonia
comments.body: It's not quite as easy to get the fish, but if you know somebody who has a colony nearby this is workable. Benghazi sells berries now tho so i don't know if it's easier to run between there and syracuse or if procuring is still the faster way to go.

comments.author: Sylvia
comments.body: Not quite as easy to get the fish? If you're a cook, you should already be working on fishing. You could easily get plenty of fish on the way to the landing zone and back, especially with the Oxford skills.
